scope: read-only source audit of the ACTUAL decode chain used by our F0/F2 evals (pod) vs official FasterWAM eval-time binarize

a3_env_gripper.meaning: A3 env expects grip command g in [-1,1]; internal gripper TARGET OPENING = (g+1)/2 in [0,1]

our_eval_decode.code: grip_cmd = float(np.clip(2.0*a[6]-1.0, -1.0, 1.0))  # a = stats.backward(act_norm) = raw opening in [0.28,1.0]
our_eval_decode.meaning: we do NOT binarize; we map continuous raw opening a -> g=2a-1 -> env -> target opening = ((2a-1)+1)/2 = a

verified_from_source.composition: env target opening == a EXACTLY (identity). 2a-1 is NOT a bug; it cancels env's (g+1)/2. No sign/threshold misalignment in the current continuous decode.

value_table.data_semantics: mid-band (model's common output) -> jaws target 0.43, likely TOO OPEN to grip a ~0.28-thickness cookie

official_fasterwam_difference.training: still continuous flow-matching action MSE; NOT a gripper classifier
official_fasterwam_difference.our_status: we REMOVED eval-time binarize; we feed continuous opening a. This is the key executor difference.

consequence_of_midband_0p43_under_two_ex.continuous(current): target opening 0.43 -> jaws stay ~0.43 open -> do NOT close on a ~0.28 cookie -> no grip -> 0 in-box (what we observe).
consequence_of_midband_0p43_under_two_ex.official_sign_binarize: g=-0.14 (a=0.43<0.5) -> sign -1 -> env opening 0.0 (fully closed) -> WOULD grip the cookie; BUT a=0.49 (release, g=-0.02<0) also -> sign -1 -> closed -> CANNOT release -> still fails exact_fill.
consequence_of_midband_0p43_under_two_ex.synthesis: With a mid-band output, CONTINUOUS fails to grip and BINARIZE fails to release. Either way exact_fill=0; the two executors fail differently. => the executor choice is NOT a free fix; the root issue remains that the MODEL OUTPUT is mid-band (~0.43) rather than crisp 0.28/1.0 (H2), plus whether autonomous states reach grasp (H3).

is_0p28_a_universal_grasp_criterion: NO. 0.28 is the jaw opening when the finger is blocked by a ~21.5mm cookie; it changes with cookie count/thickness. Do NOT use opening~0.28 as the accept/criterion; use finger FORCE + task result (in_target/exact_fill). [consistent with user]
